parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC belongs.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The region where the private gateway is located.

parameters.name: EnableAuthoritativeDns
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable authoritative DNS parsing. The default value is false.

parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the private gateway. For more information, see the private\_gateway\_id field in the response of the [ListResources](~~412133~~) operation.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual switch. For more information, see [DescribeVpcs](~~448581~~).

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information, see [DescribeVpcs](~~448581~~).
